mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for a talented Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation Testing) to join our growing Quality Engineering team.
In this role, you will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality web and mobile applications. You will perform both manual and automated testing activities, contribute to quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle, and help drive a quality-first mindset across Agile teams.
You will have opportunities to work on enterprise-scale Banking and Insurance projects, utilizing modern testing tools, automation frameworks, API testing solutions, and CI/CD practices.
 
Responsibilities
Analyze business and system requirements to create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, and user acceptance testing for web and mobile applications.
Design, execute, and maintain automated test scripts to improve test coverage and efficiency.
Conduct API testing and validate system integrations.
Support shift-left testing practices by participating early in requirement reviews and development activities.
Collaborate closely with developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
Identify, document, track, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle.
Review solution documentation and contribute to quality improvement initiatives.
Prepare test execution reports and communicate testing progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, automation frameworks, test data management, and testing standards.
yeu_cau:
Must Have
2-10 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance and Testing.
Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Strong experience in manual testing, including functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing.
Hands-on experience with test automation for web, mobile, or API testing.
Experience with at least one automation tool or framework such as:
Selenium WebDriver
Cypress
Katalon Studio
TestComplete
Or similar automation frameworks
Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI, or equivalent.
Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and QA best practices.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Experience using Jira and related collaboration/testing tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Nice to Have
Experience with Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Groovy, Python, or similar programming languages.
Experience with Mobile Automation Testing.
Experience maintaining or enhancing automation frameworks.
Knowledge of SQL and database testing.
Experience with Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with test management tools such as Xray, Zephyr, qTest, or similar.
Experience in Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance domains.
ISTQB or relevant testing certifications.
